## MPL 2.0 (Standard Text, 摘要)

完整文本见 https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/MPL/2.0/ (13 段, 13 页)

**核心条款**:

### §1-§3: 释义 + Source Code Object Code

### §3.1: 版权许可
> The Initial Developer hereby grants You a **world-wide, royalty-free, non-exclusive license** to use, reproduce, modify, display, perform, sublicense and distribute the Source Code and Object Code.

### §3.2: 专利许可
> Each Contributor hereby grants You a **world-wide, royalty-free, non-exclusive patent license**...

### §3.3: 弱 copyleft (核心差异)
> **You may distribute the Covered Software** in **Object Code form** under the terms of §3.1 + §3.2, **provided** that you also **convey the Source Code** of the Covered Software under the terms of §3.1 + §3.2 on a medium customarily used for software interchange...

**弱 copyleft 边界**:
- 你修改的 MPL 文件**必须**公开 (Source form)
- 你**不**改的 MPL 文件**不**传染
- 你整个产品**不**传染 (不像 GPL)

### §6-§8: 商标 + 无担保 + 责任限制 (类似 Apache-2.0)

### §10: 终止 (per §4 违反)
> This License and the rights granted hereunder will terminate automatically if You fail to comply...
